channel.title: The Points Guy - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Points Guy (thepointsguy.com)

item.title: Mastercard launching a sweepstakes and exclusive tickets to Noah Kahan's upcoming concert series
item.description: Enter this sweepstakes courtesy of The Mastercard Collection for access to musician Noah Kahan's upcoming summer concert series.

item.title: Earn up to 100,000 bonus miles with these limited-time United card welcome offers (worth up to $1,500)
item.description: If you're considering opening a United credit card, you want to apply at the right time. Let's look at the welcome offers on the six cobranded cards from Chase.

item.title: Book flights to Europe starting at 18,750 miles: Check out Flying Blue’s February Promo Rewards
item.description: With the latest Flying Blue Promo Rewards sale, you can book a one-way flight from the U.S. to Europe for only 18,750 miles. Here's what you should know.

item.title: 44 new Hyatt hotels where you can get 500 extra points per night
item.description: World of Hyatt offers its members 500 bonus points per night at select new hotels for a limited time after the hotel opens. Here's how to get those points.

item.title: How to transfer Chase Ultimate Rewards points to World of Hyatt
item.description: Here's a look at when and how to transfer Chase points to Hyatt. World of Hyatt offers valuable redemptions and is one of the best Chase transfer partners.

item.title: American Airlines adds 2 new Canadian routes from New York
item.description: American Airlines will link New York with Calgary and Quebec City this summer.

item.title: What are points and miles worth? TPG’s February 2026 monthly valuations
item.description: Learn how points and miles from major loyalty programs stack up. Here's how TPG values each major credit card, hotel and airline rewards currency.

item.title: Act fast: Earn the Southwest Companion Pass by booking just 1 round-trip flight
item.description: Southwest's 2026 Companion Pass promotion lets you earn this valuable perk for a fraction of the usual cost.

item.title: Credit card transfer bonuses (February): 50% bonus to Marriott Bonvoy, 30% bonus to Japan Airlines and more
item.description: Here's a look at all the current transfer bonuses involving major credit cards and airline and hotel loyalty programs.

item.title: JetBlue to offer lounge day passes at New York's JFK: Here's what it will cost
item.description: JetBlue is now allowing certain elite status members, credit card holders and Mint passengers to purchase one-time access to its new BlueHouse lounge in New York.
